cases.expected: No exception; initializeValidators() is never invoked on any JsonSchema.
cases.description: Verify that calling preloadJsonSchemas with an empty collection results in a no‑op (the loop body is never executed).

cases.expected: initializeValidators() is invoked exactly once on mockSchema1; method returns normally.
cases.description: Validate that a single JsonSchema element is processed and its initializeValidators() method is called once.

cases.expected: initializeValidators() is invoked exactly once on each of the three mock schemas; method returns normally.
cases.description: Ensure that the method iterates over all elements in a non‑empty collection and calls initializeValidators() on each.

cases.expected: RuntimeException thrown by mockSchemaThrows.initializeValidators() propagates out of preloadJsonSchemas.
cases.description: Confirm that if a schema's initializeValidators() throws an unchecked exception, the method does not catch it and the exception bubbles up.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when attempting to iterate over a null collection.
cases.description: Check the method's behavior when a null argument is supplied; the for‑each loop dereferences the collection, resulting in NPE.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when the method attempts to invoke initializeValidators() on the null element; no further schemas are processed.
cases.description: Validate that a collection containing a null entry causes a NPE during iteration, confirming the method does not guard against null elements.

cases.expected: initializeValidators() is invoked exactly twice on the same mockSchemaDup instance; method returns normally.
cases.description: Ensure that duplicate references in the collection are each processed independently, i.e., the method does not deduplicate or skip repeated schemas.

cases.expected: Error (e.g., AssertionError) thrown by mockSchemaError.initializeValidators() propagates out of preloadJsonSchemas.
cases.description: Confirm that non‑RuntimeException throwables (such as java.lang.Error) are not caught and bubble up unchanged.

cases.expected: initializeValidators() is called on mockSchemaGood; then RuntimeException from mockSchemaThrows propagates; initializeValidators() on mockSchemaLater is never invoked.
cases.description: Test that iteration stops at the first exception: earlier schemas are processed, the exception is propagated, and later schemas are not touched.

cases.expected: initializeValidators() is invoked once on each of mockSchemaA and mockSchemaB; method returns normally.
cases.description: Verify that the method works with a Set implementation, confirming that order does not affect the invocation of initializeValidators on each element.

cases.expected: ConcurrentModificationException is thrown when a schema's initializeValidators() method modifies the same collection being iterated, causing the for‑each loop to detect concurrent modification.
cases.description: Validate that the method does not swallow ConcurrentModificationException caused by a schema adding/removing elements from the collection during iteration.

cases.expected: RuntimeException (e.g., IllegalStateException) thrown by the collection's iterator() method propagates out of preloadJsonSchemas.
cases.description: Confirm that if the collection's iterator() implementation throws an unchecked exception when the for‑each loop attempts to obtain the iterator, the exception bubbles up unchanged.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown because the collection's iterator() method returns null, leading the for‑each construct to dereference a null iterator.
cases.description: Ensure that a collection returning a null iterator causes a NullPointerException during iteration, demonstrating that the method does not guard against malformed iterables.
